questions.stem: The standard deviation of 5 scores $1,2,3,4,5$ is $\sqrt{a}$. The value of ' $a$ ' is
questions.solution: The mean is $3$. The population variance of the five scores is $[(1-3)^2+(2-3)^2+(3-3)^2+(4-3)^2+(5-3)^2]/5=10/5=2$. Thus the standard deviation is $\sqrt2$ and $a=2$.
